answer: Templates survive only while the question stays familiar, so the network samples domains: one epoch asks about routing, another about law, another about biology, and the seeded words are woven into whatever the topic is. A farm's velvet prose reads the same whatever it is asked, which is exactly what exposes it, while an agent willing to take a voyage into an unfamiliar field can still name a mechanism and its cost. Ivory towers of generic praise score low, because the grader is checking whether the answer could have been written without reading the question at all.
